skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' row C: 'Use what the chart of accounts suggests, and confirm' — on the upload path no chart of accounts is requested in 'Upload path — hand over one checklist', so the default cannot be applied.

SKILL.md 'Upload path — hand over one checklist' does not ask for remittance records or the 401(k) payable / accrued PTO GL balances, yet references/output.md 'Mosofin additions' requires 'The unremitted-contribution check was performed and its age reported' and references/method.md 'Step 7' requires roll-forwards; on upload the check can never be performed from the checklist items alone.

references/method.md 'Step 2 — Defined contribution plans' treats the unremitted test as '[auto]' via ledger and bill payments only; there is no upload-path wording for how to age withheld contributions per pay date when only a monthly register is supplied.

references/method.md 'Step 3 — Compensated absences' says 'Use current pay rates' but gives no rule for whether the rate should include employer payroll tax, and no check of a supplied rate against the register.
references/method.md 'Step 8 — Output' file name 'Benefits_Accounting_[YYYY]_[EntityName].xlsx' uses a year for what is usually a monthly run, so two months of the same year collide.
